name: ugc-pilot
description: Use your UGC Pilot account to generate images and short videos, manage media, and retrieve finished results.

interface.shortDescription: Images and videos in your AI
interface.longDescription: Connect your own UGC Pilot account. Create images and 3–10 second videos, use owned image references, browse your media, and retrieve completed outputs. Generation uses your UGC Pilot plan and credits. This private beta does not publish social posts or create carousels.
defaultPrompt: Check my UGC Pilot connection, plan, credits, and generation options without generating anything.
Use UGC Pilot to create one vertical product image.
Use UGC Pilot to animate an image from my library into a five-second vertical video.
